content.short: Bubblemaps is an on-chain analytics tool designed for tokens and NFTs.
content.description: Bubblemaps is an on-chain analytics tool for tokens and NFTs. Its playful, engaging visual interface makes on-chain data easier to access and lowers the entry barrier for users. There is a strong demand for easy and accessible blockchain data. Block explorers such as Etherscan are often too complex for the average user and mainly appeal to technical profiles like traders, engineers, and developers. Bubblemaps aims to onboard the remaining 90% of DeFi users by reimagining blockchain data in a colorful, interactive way, making research fun and convenient, and placing users at the center of smart decision-making.
